description: Dry run of the warehouses one marketplace sells from; nothing is written or sent. The channel would publish each tracked product's units on these warehouses minus the units open orders hold there (a bundle: whole bundles its components there can make), and its orders would take units from them in this order. Returns total and changed product counts, paused products, a truncation flag, before/after samples and a signed previewToken valid for 15 minutes. Refused when the workspace keeps one count per product. Read get_stock_sources and list_warehouses first; show the person these numbers, then call set_channel_warehouses with the SAME platform, warehouseIds and token.

platform.description: The marketplace slug from list_marketplaces whose warehouses change; get_stock_sources lists the channels that take a list.

warehouseIds.description: The warehouses the channel sells from, in the order its orders take units: own warehouses or supplier showcases (kind own or supplier in list_warehouses), each once, at most 20. null removes the list, so the channel publishes each product's total again.
